reason: Implements 47 registered tools for offline GTM export inspection, editing, audit, server-side entity inspection, and file export; functional limitations are documented.
exposure: All 47 tools by default. Presence of GTM_READ_ONLY filters create/update/delete/move/export prefixes; other tools remain registered. All groups, including serverSide, are unconditional.
limitations: Runtime verification was limited to tools/list; no container or GTM tool handler was invoked.
This server works on local exported JSON only; it has no live Google API, authentication, workspace sync, publishing, or preview execution.
GTM_READ_ONLY removes only create/update/delete/move/export prefixes; undo, redo, and loading remain exposed.
Tag/trigger/variable create and update tool parameters permit only scalar value fields and cannot represent the nested LIST/MAP parameter shapes accepted in container-file schemas.

Trigger filter tool objects expose type/key/value/condition but underlying ConditionSchema models type/parameter; passthrough preserves extra fields without translating them to canonical GTM condition parameters.
gtm_get_tag_dependencies omits variable dependencies, gtm_diff_containers omits changes to existing IDs, and lifecycle firing-order/consent conclusions are project heuristics.
Folder deletion does not clear entity references; moving tags between folders leaves old membership and can duplicate destination membership.
Server-side entity schemas impose project-specific required fields (including zone type); supported exported JSON shapes are constrained by these schemas rather than Google discovery schemas.

tools.name: gtm_load_container
tools.description: Load a GTM container JSON file. Call this first before using any other tools.

file_path.description: Path to the GTM export JSON file

tools.behavior: Reads and validates a local exported GTM JSON file, normalizes entity placement, and resets in-memory undo/redo history.

tools.name: gtm_get_container_info
tools.description: Get container metadata (name, ID, timezone, platform). Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Returns loaded container metadata with human-readable usage context names.

tools.name: gtm_get_container_state
tools.description: Get summary counts and structure overview of the loaded container.
tools.behavior: Returns loaded entity counts and source file path.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags with summary info, trigger assignments, and consent settings. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Returns summaries of tags from the local loaded container.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get full tag configuration by tag_id or name. Requires a loaded container.

name.description: Tag name to look up (alternative to tag_id)

tools.behavior: Returns the local tag selected by ID or exact name.

tools.name: gtm_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag. Validates against GTM schema, auto-assigns tagId if not provided.

type.description: Tag type code (e.g. gaawe for GA4, googtag for Google Tag, html for Custom HTML)

enabled.description: Whether the tag is enabled (default: true)

parameters.description: Tag configuration parameters (e.g. html content for Custom HTML tags)

firing_trigger_ids.description: Firing trigger IDs for the tag

blocking_trigger_ids.description: Blocking trigger IDs for the tag

consent_types.description: Required consent types (e.g. ad_storage, analytics_storage). Empty array means no consent required.

tools.behavior: Creates a tag in the local in-memory container with project Zod validation and automatically assigned ID.
tools.exposure: Default; omitted whenever GTM_READ_ONLY is present, regardless of its value.

tools.name: gtm_update_tag
tools.description: Update an existing tag by tag_id.

firing_trigger_ids.description: Replace the tag's firing trigger IDs

blocking_trigger_ids.description: Replace the tag's blocking trigger IDs

consent_types.description: Replace required additional consent types; an empty array marks no additional consent required

tools.behavior: Updates a tag in the local in-memory container after project Zod validation.
tools.exposure: Default; omitted whenever GTM_READ_ONLY is present, regardless of its value.

tools.name: gtm_delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a tag from the container by tag_id.
tools.behavior: Deletes a tag in the local in-memory container without cleaning references from other entities.
tools.exposure: Default; omitted whenever GTM_READ_ONLY is present, regardless of its value.

tools.name: gtm_move_tag_to_folder
tools.description: Move a tag to a folder, or unassign it by setting folder_id to null.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag_dependencies
tools.description: Show which triggers and variables a tag references. Requires a loaded container.

name.description: Tag name to analyze (alternative to tag_id)

tools.behavior: Returns firing and blocking trigger references for a tag; contrary to its description it does not return variable references.

tools.name: gtm_find_unused_entities
tools.description: Find tags, triggers, or variables not referenced by any other entity. Variables are classified by type (data_layer, custom_js, constant, lookup_table, etc.) and only those with no parameter references anywhere are reported unused. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Finds unreferenced triggers and variable names and tags whose enabled property is falsy; omitted enabled values may be reported unused.

tools.name: gtm_find_orphaned_triggers
tools.description: Find triggers not fired by any tag. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Returns triggers absent from tag firing-trigger IDs; blocking-only trigger use is not counted.

tools.name: gtm_validate_container
tools.description: Run full Zod validation on the loaded container, report all issues. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Validates in-memory export against project Zod schemas and returns schema issues.

tools.name: gtm_export_container
tools.description: Write current container state to a JSON file. The file can be imported back into GTM.

file_path.description: Output file path for the exported container JSON

tools.behavior: Writes the current in-memory export to a local JSON file while preserving the original workspace envelope when detected.
tools.exposure: Default; omitted whenever GTM_READ_ONLY is present, regardless of its value.

tools.name: gtm_diff_containers
tools.description: Compare two container JSON files and report differences in tags, triggers, and variables.

file_a.description: Path to the first GTM container JSON file

file_b.description: Path to the second GTM container JSON file

tools.behavior: Reads two local exports and compares entity IDs for additions, removals, and counts; configuration changes to existing IDs are not compared.

tools.name: gtm_analyze_tag_firing_order
tools.description: Analyze the deterministic tag firing order for the loaded container. Reports the evaluation sequence (Google tags → Custom HTML → Custom Image → Custom Templates), position within each group, sequencing dependencies (fires after/before), and potential ordering conflicts. Critical for understanding consent timing and tag execution order. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Estimates firing order by hard-coded tag-type groups and numeric tag IDs and reports sequencing references; it does not execute or simulate GTM.

tools.name: gtm_analyze_consent_setup
tools.description: Analyze the container's consent management configuration. Detects consent management tags, consent state variables, consent blocking triggers, and consent initialization patterns. Reports issues like unprotected data collection tags, consent timing problems, orphaned blocking references, and missing consent setup. Issues are classified as critical/warning/info with recommendations. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Uses keyword, tag-type, parameter, and trigger heuristics to report consent patterns and potential issues.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag_lifecycle
tools.description: Get detailed lifecycle analysis for a specific tag. Reports the lifecycle phase (consent_management, data_collection, other), firing order position, trigger configuration, sequencing dependencies, consent relationships, and per-tag issues. Use to debug why a specific tag might fire at the wrong time or violate consent requirements. Requires a loaded container.

name.description: Tag name to analyze (alternative to tag_id)

tools.behavior: Reports heuristic lifecycle phase, computed firing group, trigger relationships, consent settings, and issues for a selected tag.

tools.name: gtm_search
tools.description: Search across all entities (tags, triggers, variables, folders) by name or notes. Returns matching entities with their type and summary info. Requires a loaded container.

query.description: Search query (matched against entity names and notes)

tools.behavior: Searches local tag, trigger, variable, and folder names and notes with optional case sensitivity.

tools.name: gtm_undo
tools.description: Undo the last mutation (create, update, delete, move) made to the container. Returns the previous state summary. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Restores a prior in-memory container snapshot and returns state and history counts.
tools.exposure: Default and GTM_READ_ONLY mode; these state-changing tools are not covered by the write-prefix filter.

tools.name: gtm_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone mutation. Returns the restored state summary. Requires a loaded container.
tools.behavior: Restores a previously undone in-memory snapshot and returns state and history counts.
tools.exposure: Default and GTM_READ_ONLY mode; these state-changing tools are not covered by the write-prefix filter.

review.summary: Edits exported container JSON, manages server-side entities, analyzes dependencies, and supports undo and redo.
